**The build passes now, exit 0.** Two real bugs from the bump, not noise.

`[options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6)` read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. It now takes either. `[retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7)` threw on an unset flag. Unset now means `false`, the old default.

8 warnings remain. All are deprecation notices in `src/legacy`, `punycode`, and `crypto.createCipher`. Those files are not in this tree. Say the word and I will chase them where they live.
